{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
sales = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue_clean'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter out QA orders and refunded orders
valid_sales = sales[
    (sales['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99) &
    (sales['status'] == 'completed')
]

# Filter out missing age (customer_age == -1)
valid_age = valid_sales[valid_sales['customer_age'] != -1]

# Compute and print counts and mean
n_total = len(sales)
n_missing_age = (sales['customer_age'] == -1).sum()
n_qa_orders = (sales['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99).sum()
n_refunded = (sales['status'] == 'refunded').sum()
n_valid_sales = len(valid_sales)
n_valid_age = len(valid_age)
mean_age = valid_age['customer_age'].mean()

print(f"Total rows: {n_total}")
print(f"Rows with missing age (customer_age == -1): {n_missing_age}")
print(f"QA orders (revenue == 999999.99): {n_qa_orders}")
print(f"Refunded orders (status == 'refunded'): {n_refunded}")
print(f"Valid orders (completed, non-QA): {n_valid_sales}")
print(f"Valid customers with known age: {n_valid_age}")
print(f"Mean age of valid customers: {mean_age}")"}
